blocks.zh: 全球供應鏈：概述、角色責任、歐盟與非洲供應鏈
blocks.en: Global Supply Chain: Overview, Roles and Responsibilities, EU and African Supply Chains

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解製藥供應鏈的完整結構：從製造商→批發商→醫療機構/藥局→患者的各環節，以及第一哩/中間哩/最後一哩的定義
blocks.en: Understand the complete structure of the pharmaceutical supply chain: each link from manufacturer → wholesaler → healthcare facility/pharmacy → patient, and the definitions of first mile, middle mile and last mile

blocks.zh: 掌握各角色的GDP責任：製造商責任邊界、批發商授權要求、醫療機構的末端責任，以及質量協議的角色
blocks.en: Understand the GDP responsibilities of each role: the manufacturer's boundary of responsibility, wholesaler authorization requirements, the end-point responsibilities of healthcare facilities, and the role of quality agreements

blocks.zh: 了解歐盟GDP指南（2013/C 343/01）的核心要求，包括溫度分類、批發授權與公共服務義務
blocks.en: Understand the core requirements of the EU GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01), including temperature categories, wholesale authorization and public service obligations

blocks.zh: 認識非洲供應鏈挑戰：非正規分銷、仿冒藥風險、WHO預認證機制及塞內加爾典型案例
blocks.en: Recognize the challenges of African supply chains: informal distribution, counterfeit medicine risk, the WHO Prequalification mechanism and the typical Senegal case

blocks.en: On This Page

blocks.zh: Complexity • Stakeholders • Public vs. Private • 供應鏈複雜性與雙軌體系
blocks.en: Complexity • Stakeholders • Public vs. Private

blocks.zh: 解析：供應鏈概述
blocks.en: Analysis: Supply Chain Overview

blocks.zh: 台灣藥品供應鏈對比：健保制度下的特殊配送結構
blocks.en: Comparison with the Taiwan Drug Supply Chain: A Distinctive Distribution Structure under National Health Insurance

blocks.zh: 台灣藥品配送與歐盟模式有顯著差異：
blocks.en: Drug distribution in Taiwan differs markedly from the EU model:

blocks.zh: 醫院直接採購：大型醫學中心（台大、長庚）多從原廠/代理商直接採購，繞過傳統批發商
blocks.en: Direct hospital purchasing: large medical centers (National Taiwan University Hospital, Chang Gung) mostly purchase directly from the original manufacturer or its agent, bypassing the traditional wholesaler

blocks.zh: 健保給付驅動：藥品價格由健保署核定，通路利潤空間有限，批發商角色相對壓縮
blocks.en: National Health Insurance (NHI) reimbursement as the driver: drug prices are set by the NHI Administration, leaving limited margin in the distribution channel and squeezing the wholesaler's role

blocks.zh: 藥局配送：社區藥局透過全國型批發商（如國藥、永信）供貨，最後一哩由藥師直接給付患者
blocks.en: Pharmacy supply: community pharmacies are supplied through nationwide wholesalers (the distribution arms of major local pharmaceutical groups), and in the last mile the pharmacist dispenses directly to the patient

blocks.zh: 冷鏈相對集中：因島嶼地形，冷鏈配送距離較短，但偏鄉（原住民部落、離島）仍存在最後一哩挑戰
blocks.en: Relatively concentrated cold chain: because of the island's geography, cold chain distances are short, but remote areas (indigenous communities, outlying islands) still face last mile challenges

blocks.zh: 為什麼最後一哩最難控制？
blocks.en: Why Is the Last Mile the Hardest to Control?

blocks.zh: 每往下一層，供應鏈管控能力系統性下降：
blocks.en: At each step down the supply chain, control capability falls systematically:

blocks.zh: GDP知識：製造商100% → 批發商80% → 藥局/診所40% → 患者<5%
blocks.en: GDP knowledge: manufacturer 100% → wholesaler 80% → pharmacy/clinic 40% → patient <5%

blocks.zh: 設備條件：工業級冷藏倉庫 → 商用冷藏車 → 家用冰箱（溫度不穩定）
blocks.en: Equipment: industrial cold storage warehouse → commercial refrigerated truck → household refrigerator (unstable temperature)

blocks.zh: 監管力度：製造廠定期GMP查廠 → 批發商定期GDP稽核 → 診所/藥局抽查 → 患者端完全無監管
blocks.en: Regulatory oversight: regular GMP inspection of manufacturing sites → regular GDP audits of wholesalers → spot checks of clinics/pharmacies → no oversight at all at the patient end

blocks.zh: 這正是TR46聚焦「最後一哩GDP」的核心原因。
blocks.en: This is precisely why TR46 focuses on "last mile GDP".

blocks.zh: 供應鏈風險累積原理
blocks.en: Principle of Supply Chain Risk Accumulation

blocks.zh:
供應鏈節點數量 ↑  →  潛在風險暴露點 ↑
每個節點 = 潛在溫度偏差點 + 文件斷鏈點 + 責任模糊地帶

風險 = Σ(節點風險) × 節點間交接品質係數
blocks.en:
Number of supply chain nodes ↑  →  potential risk exposure points ↑
Each node = potential temperature deviation point + documentation break point + area of ambiguous responsibility

Risk = Σ(node risk) × handover quality factor between nodes

blocks.zh: 最後一哩的特殊性：節點數雖少，但每個節點的管控係數最低，導致單位節點風險最高。
blocks.en: The special nature of the last mile: there are few nodes, but each node has the lowest control factor, so the risk per node is the highest.

blocks.zh: Internal vs. External • First / Middle / Last Mile • Figure 3.1-1🔍 • 內部與外部配送，三哩定義
blocks.en: Internal vs. External • First / Middle / Last Mile • Figure 3.1-1🔍

blocks.zh: 解析：三哩配送與供應鏈層級
blocks.en: Analysis: Three-Mile Distribution and Supply Chain Levels

blocks.zh: 比喻：物流業的最後一哩困境
blocks.en: Analogy: The Last Mile Dilemma in Logistics

blocks.zh: 電商物流中，將包裹從倉庫送到客戶家門的「最後一公里」成本佔整個物流成本的28-50%，因為這段路需要最多人力、行程最碎片化。藥品供應鏈的最後一哩面臨相似困境：
blocks.en: In e-commerce logistics, the "last mile" of getting a parcel from the warehouse to the customer's door accounts for 28-50% of total logistics cost, because this leg needs the most labor and the most fragmented routing. The pharmaceutical supply chain's last mile faces a similar dilemma:

blocks.zh: 每筆訂單量小，冷鏈設備利用率低
blocks.en: Each order is small, so cold chain equipment utilization is low

blocks.zh: 接收方（患者/診所）專業度參差不齊
blocks.en: Recipients (patients/clinics) vary widely in professional competence

blocks.zh: 問題發生後難以追溯（記錄往往缺失）
blocks.en: Problems are hard to trace after they occur (records are often missing)

blocks.zh: TR46的目標正是為這段最脆弱的路程建立GDP標準。
blocks.en: TR46's goal is precisely to establish GDP standards for this most vulnerable stretch.

blocks.zh: 公私雙軌供應鏈（Public vs. Private）
blocks.en: Public vs. Private Supply Chains

blocks.zh: 許多國家同時存在兩套供應鏈，各有不同的GDP監管框架：
blocks.en: Many countries have two parallel supply chains, each with a different GDP regulatory framework:

blocks.zh: 公共供應鏈（政府管理）：疫苗、瘧疾/HIV藥物，透過中央→地區→區域政府配送中心層層下達，常有NGO捐贈介入
blocks.en: Public supply chain (government-managed): vaccines, malaria/HIV medicines, distributed down through central → regional → district government distribution centers, often with NGO donations involved

blocks.zh: 私人供應鏈（批發商主導）：商業藥品，透過批發商→藥局/診所→患者，由GDP批發授權管控
blocks.en: Private supply chain (wholesaler-led): commercial medicines, distributed through wholesalers → pharmacies/clinics → patients, controlled by GDP wholesale authorization

blocks.zh: 兩套體系的最後一哩均面臨相同挑戰，但公共供應鏈在低收入國家的基礎設施落差更顯著。
blocks.en: Both systems face the same last mile challenges, but the infrastructure gap in the public supply chain is more pronounced in low-income countries.

blocks.zh: MAH（Marketing Authorization Holder）在配送中的責任邊界
blocks.en: Boundary of Responsibility of the MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder) in Distribution

blocks.zh: MAH在內部配送期間始終擁有產品所有權，責任最重。一旦轉移至外部配送，所有權轉移，但MAH仍需確保：
blocks.en: The MAH retains ownership of the product throughout internal distribution and carries the greatest responsibility. Once the product moves to external distribution, ownership is transferred, but the MAH must still ensure that:

blocks.zh: 授權有資質的批發商承接外部配送
blocks.en: Qualified wholesalers are authorized to take on external distribution

blocks.zh: 建立技術協議（Technical Agreement）規定儲存/運輸條件
blocks.en: A technical agreement is established specifying storage/transport conditions

blocks.zh: MAH可在某些國家同時持有批發配送授權，直接管理中間哩和最後一哩
blocks.en: In some countries the MAH may also hold a wholesale distribution authorization and directly manage the middle mile and last mile

blocks.zh: Manufacturer • Wholesaler • 3PL • Inspectorate • Quality Agreement • 各角色定義與質量責任
blocks.en: Manufacturer • Wholesaler • 3PL • Inspectorate • Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: 解析：各角色的GDP責任矩陣
blocks.en: Analysis: GDP Responsibility Matrix by Role

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement（質量協議）：每個交接點的關鍵
blocks.en: Quality Agreement: The Key at Every Handover Point

blocks.zh: 在供應鏈每個所有權或責任交接點，書面質量協議是防止「責任真空」的核心工具：
blocks.en: At every point where ownership or responsibility is handed over in the supply chain, a written quality agreement is the core tool for preventing a "responsibility vacuum":

blocks.zh: MAH ↔ 批發商：明確產品儲存溫度要求、溫差記錄義務、超温處理程序
blocks.en: MAH ↔ wholesaler: clear product storage temperature requirements, temperature record obligations and procedures for handling excursions

blocks.zh: 批發商 ↔ 3PL：規定冷藏車溫度範圍、記錄器要求、偏差通報時限
blocks.en: Wholesaler ↔ 3PL: specify the refrigerated vehicle temperature range, data logger requirements and deviation reporting timelines

blocks.zh: 批發商 ↔ 醫院/藥局：明確交貨時的溫度確認程序、拒收標準
blocks.en: Wholesaler ↔ hospital/pharmacy: clear temperature verification procedures at delivery and acceptance/rejection criteria

blocks.zh: 沒有質量協議的交接點，就是供應鏈中最脆弱的斷鏈風險點。
blocks.en: A handover point without a quality agreement is the most vulnerable break-in-the-chain risk point in the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 批發商授權（Wholesale Distribution Authorization, WDA）的核心要求
blocks.en: Core Requirements for a Wholesale Distribution Authorization (WDA)

blocks.zh: 在歐盟及多數監管體系下，取得WDA的最低要求包括：
blocks.en: In the EU and most regulatory systems, the minimum requirements for obtaining a WDA include:

blocks.zh: 合格責任人（Qualified Person for Distribution, QPD）：具備適當資質的GDP負責人
blocks.en: Qualified Person for Distribution (QPD): a GDP person in charge with appropriate qualifications

blocks.zh: 適當的設施：足夠且符合要求的倉儲空間，包括溫控區域
blocks.en: Suitable facilities: adequate storage space that meets requirements, including temperature-controlled areas

blocks.zh: GDP合規體系：質量管理體系、SOP、偏差管理、CAPA
blocks.en: GDP compliance system: quality management system, SOPs, deviation management, CAPA

blocks.zh: 應急計畫：產品召回程序、應對自然災害的業務連續性計畫
blocks.en: Contingency plans: product recall procedures and business continuity plans for natural disasters

blocks.zh: 可追溯性：完整的進銷記錄，支持藥品序列化追蹤
blocks.en: Traceability: complete records of purchases and sales, supporting medicine serialization tracking

blocks.zh: 台灣藥品批發商的許可要求由衛福部食藥署（TFDA）依《藥事法》及相關辦法規定，與歐盟WDA架構高度相似。
blocks.en: In Taiwan, the licensing requirements for drug wholesalers are set by the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) of the Ministry of Health and Welfare under the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act and related regulations, and are highly similar to the EU WDA framework.

blocks.zh: 3PL（第三方物流）的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Position of the 3PL (Third-Party Logistics Provider)

blocks.zh: 3PL代表製造商或批發商執行物流作業，但不擁有產品。在GDP框架下：
blocks.en: A 3PL performs logistics operations on behalf of the manufacturer or wholesaler but does not own the product. Under the GDP framework:

blocks.zh: 3PL的行為視同委託方行為，委託方（MAH/批發商）仍負最終責任
blocks.en: The 3PL's actions are treated as the actions of the contract giver (MAH/wholesaler), who retains ultimate responsibility

blocks.zh: 必須簽訂書面合約，明確GDP責任分工
blocks.en: A written contract must be signed, clearly dividing GDP responsibilities

blocks.zh: 3PL必須接受委託方的定期稽核
blocks.en: The 3PL must accept periodic audits by the contract giver

blocks.zh: EU GDP 2013/C 343/01 • Full-line Wholesaler • Public Service Obligation • Temperature Categories • 歐盟GDP指南與溫度管理
blocks.en: EU GDP 2013/C 343/01 • Full-line Wholesaler • Public Service Obligation • Temperature Categories

blocks.zh: 解析：歐盟GDP體系深度解析
blocks.en: Analysis: In-Depth Look at the EU GDP System

blocks.zh: 溫度類別詳解：從液氮到常溫
blocks.en: Temperature Categories Explained: From Liquid Nitrogen to Ambient

blocks.zh: 供應鏈溫度管理的五個層級，冷鏈設備需求與成本依序遞減：
blocks.en: Supply chain temperature management has five tiers, with cold chain equipment requirements and costs decreasing in sequence:

blocks.zh: 深冷（-196°C）：液氮容器（Dewar flask），用於細胞治療產品。最後一哩的超難挑戰——患者端幾乎不可能具備液氮設施，通常需要在醫院完成給藥。
blocks.en: Cryogenic (-196°C): liquid nitrogen containers (Dewar flasks), used for cell therapy products. An extreme last mile challenge, as patients can hardly ever have liquid nitrogen facilities, so administration usually has to take place at the hospital.

blocks.zh: 冷凍（-25 ~ -15°C）：工業/商用冷凍庫、冷凍車。mRNA疫苗（輝瑞/莫德納）的超低溫（-70°C/-20°C）要求在COVID-19期間凸顯了最後一哩挑戰。
blocks.en: Frozen (-25 to -15°C): industrial/commercial freezers and freezer trucks. The ultra-low temperature requirements of mRNA vaccines (Pfizer/Moderna) (-70°C/-20°C) highlighted last mile challenges during COVID-19.

blocks.zh: 冷藏（2~8°C）：最常見的冷鏈需求。胰島素患者每日自注射，家用冰箱是最後一哩的主要儲存設備，溫度波動風險最高。
blocks.en: Refrigerated (2-8°C): the most common cold chain need. Insulin patients self-inject daily, and the household refrigerator is the main last mile storage equipment, with the highest risk of temperature fluctuation.

blocks.zh: 受控常溫（15~25°C）：看似容易，實則夏季台灣室溫常超過28-33°C，需特別注意車輛/物流中心溫控。
blocks.en: Controlled room temperature (15-25°C): seems easy, but in summer Taiwan's room temperature often exceeds 28-33°C, so vehicle/logistics center temperature control needs special attention.

blocks.zh: 常溫（≤30°C）：一般藥品，但仍需避光、防潮。
blocks.en: Ambient (≤30°C): general medicines, but protection from light and moisture is still required.

blocks.zh: Qualified Person for Distribution (QPD)：EU GDP的關鍵角色
blocks.en: Qualified Person for Distribution (QPD): A Key Role in EU GDP

blocks.zh: 類似製造端的Qualified Person（QP），EU GDP要求批發商指定一名具備GDP知識與經驗的合格責任人（QPD），負責：
blocks.en: Similar to the Qualified Person (QP) on the manufacturing side, EU GDP requires a wholesaler to designate a Qualified Person for Distribution (QPD) with GDP knowledge and experience, who is responsible for:

blocks.zh: 確保批發活動符合EU GDP指南
blocks.en: Ensuring that wholesale activities comply with the EU GDP Guidelines

blocks.zh: 監督質量管理體系的建立與維護
blocks.en: Overseeing the establishment and maintenance of the quality management system

blocks.zh: 偏差、投訴及召回的最終責任人
blocks.en: Ultimate responsibility for deviations, complaints and recalls

blocks.zh: 代表公司接受稽查機關查核
blocks.en: Representing the company during inspections by the inspectorate

blocks.zh: QPD的存在確保批發配送端有一個「有名有姓」的GDP責任人——這是最後一哩問題中最缺乏的元素。
blocks.en: The QPD ensures that the wholesale distribution end has a named person accountable for GDP, which is the element most lacking in last mile problems.

blocks.zh: EU FMD（Falsified Medicines Directive）序列化要求
blocks.en: EU FMD (Falsified Medicines Directive) Serialization Requirements

blocks.zh: EU Directive 2011/62/EU（防仿冒藥品指令）自2019年起要求：
blocks.en: Since 2019, EU Directive 2011/62/EU (the Falsified Medicines Directive) has required:

blocks.zh: 唯一識別碼（Unique Identifier）：每個藥品包裝的二維碼包含：產品代碼、序列號、批號、有效期
blocks.en: Unique Identifier: the 2D code on every medicine pack contains the product code, serial number, batch number and expiry date

blocks.zh: 防拆封裝置（Anti-tampering Device）：包裝一旦開啟即可視覺識別
blocks.en: Anti-tampering Device: the pack can be visually identified as opened once it has been opened

blocks.zh: 核實義務：藥局在配藥前必須掃描驗證序列號（連接歐盟醫藥核實系統EMVS）
blocks.en: Verification obligation: pharmacies must scan and verify the serial number before dispensing (connected to the European Medicines Verification System, EMVS)

blocks.zh: 這是EU最後一哩GDP的重要工具——確保到達患者手中的藥品未被偽造或掉包。台灣目前尚無全面強制藥品序列化，但已在規劃推動。
blocks.en: This is an important last mile GDP tool in the EU, ensuring that medicines reaching patients have not been falsified or substituted. Taiwan does not yet have comprehensive mandatory medicine serialization, but is planning to promote it.

blocks.zh: Public Service Obligation：為什麼批發商要有「義務」？
blocks.en: Public Service Obligation: Why Do Wholesalers Have an "Obligation"?

blocks.zh: 純粹市場機制下，批發商只會服務利潤高的城市地區，偏遠地區或小量需求的藥品可能面臨缺藥。PSO要求批發商：
blocks.en: Under purely market mechanisms, wholesalers would serve only profitable urban areas, and remote areas or low-volume medicines could face shortages. The PSO requires wholesalers to:

blocks.zh: 覆蓋指定地理區域的所有藥品需求（不論利潤）
blocks.en: Cover all medicine needs in a designated geographical area (regardless of profit)

blocks.zh: 維持「緩衝庫存」（buffer stocks）確保供應連續性
blocks.en: Maintain buffer stocks to ensure continuity of supply

blocks.zh: 通常在同日或24小時內送達
blocks.en: Usually deliver on the same day or within 24 hours

blocks.zh: 這在本質上是一種「公共服務交叉補貼」機制，確保最後一哩不因商業考量而斷鏈。
blocks.en: In essence this is a "public service cross-subsidy" mechanism, ensuring the last mile is not broken by commercial considerations.

blocks.zh: EU GDP 2013/C 343/01 vs 主要GDP指南對比
blocks.en: EU GDP 2013/C 343/01 vs. Major GDP Guidelines

blocks.zh: 台灣藥品GDP規範主要參考PIC/S GDP（台灣為PIC/S成員）。TFDA的《藥品優良運銷準則》與PIC/S GDP高度接軌。
blocks.en: Taiwan's drug GDP requirements mainly reference PIC/S GDP (Taiwan is a PIC/S member). TFDA's Good Distribution Practice for Drugs is highly aligned with PIC/S GDP.

blocks.zh: Informal Supply Chains • Counterfeit Risk • WHO Prequalification • Senegal Case Study • 非洲供應鏈挑戰與WHO預認證
blocks.en: Informal Supply Chains • Counterfeit Risk • WHO Prequalification • Senegal Case Study

blocks.zh: 解析：非洲供應鏈的三大挑戰
blocks.en: Analysis: Three Major Challenges of African Supply Chains

blocks.zh: 挑戰一：基礎設施（Infrastructure）
blocks.en: Challenge 1: Infrastructure

blocks.zh: 非洲最後一哩的基礎設施缺口在全球最為嚴峻：
blocks.en: Africa's last mile infrastructure gap is the most severe in the world:

blocks.zh: 電力不穩：撒哈拉以南非洲平均每天停電4-8小時，冷藏倉庫溫度波動成為常態。柴油發電機是常見備援，但燃料成本高且供應不穩定。
blocks.en: Unstable electricity: sub-Saharan Africa averages 4-8 hours of power outage per day, so temperature fluctuation in cold storage warehouses is the norm. Diesel generators are a common backup, but fuel is costly and supply is unreliable.

blocks.zh: 道路品質：雨季道路泥濘甚至無法通行，冰鎮箱（Cold box）和疫苗載體（Vaccine carrier）成為唯一可行的最後一哩冷鏈工具。
blocks.en: Road quality: in the rainy season roads turn to mud or become impassable, and cold boxes and vaccine carriers become the only viable last mile cold chain tools.

blocks.zh: 替代配送模式：摩托車（motorcycles）、自行車、獨木舟是農村最後一哩的實際配送方式。WHO的EPI（擴大免疫規劃）針對這些場景設計了適合的疫苗包裝規格。
blocks.en: Alternative delivery modes: motorcycles, bicycles and canoes are the actual last mile delivery methods in rural areas. WHO's EPI (Expanded Programme on Immunization) has designed suitable vaccine packaging specifications for these scenarios.

blocks.zh: 挑戰二：監管執法能力（Regulatory Enforcement）
blocks.en: Challenge 2: Regulatory Enforcement

blocks.zh: 非洲各國監管能力差異懸殊：
blocks.en: Regulatory capacity varies enormously across African countries:

blocks.zh: NMRAs能力不足：許多國家的國家藥品監管機構（NMRA）僅有不到20名員工，難以對全國批發商、零售藥局進行系統性GDP稽核
blocks.en: Insufficient NMRA capacity: in many countries the National Medicines Regulatory Authority (NMRA) has fewer than 20 staff, making it difficult to conduct systematic GDP audits of wholesalers and retail pharmacies nationwide

blocks.zh: 非正規市場管控空白：露天市場和無牌販售者在許多國家處於監管真空，執法行動偶發且缺乏持續性
blocks.en: Control gaps in the informal market: open-air markets and unlicensed sellers operate in a regulatory vacuum in many countries, and enforcement actions are sporadic and lack continuity

blocks.zh: 進展中的合作：非洲藥品監管協調（AMRH）計畫與非洲藥品局（AMA，2023年成立）正在推動監管能力建設和協調工作
blocks.en: Cooperation in progress: the African Medicines Regulatory Harmonisation (AMRH) program and the African Medicines Agency (AMA, established in 2023) are advancing regulatory capacity building and harmonization

blocks.zh: 挑戰三：非正規市場與仿冒藥（Informal Market & SF Medicines）
blocks.en: Challenge 3: Informal Market & SF Medicines

blocks.zh: 非洲仿冒/劣質藥品問題在全球最嚴重：
blocks.en: Africa's problem of counterfeit/substandard medicines is the most serious in the world:

blocks.zh: 規模：WHO估計低中收入國家每10份藥品中有1份為劣質或偽造（Substandard & Falsified, SF）
blocks.en: Scale: WHO estimates that 1 in 10 medicines in low- and middle-income countries is substandard or falsified (Substandard & Falsified, SF)

blocks.zh: 高風險品類：抗瘧疾藥（青蒿素類）、抗生素、抗結核藥是偽造最多的品類，直接導致治療失敗和抗藥性
blocks.en: High-risk categories: antimalarials (artemisinin-based), antibiotics and anti-tuberculosis medicines are the most falsified categories, directly causing treatment failure and drug resistance

blocks.zh: 近端原因：正規渠道藥品價格不可及（affordability）、供應短缺是患者轉向非正規市場的主因
blocks.en: Proximate causes: unaffordable prices (affordability) of medicines in formal channels and supply shortages are the main reasons patients turn to the informal market

blocks.zh: 塞內加爾案例：西非藥品配送的典型模式
blocks.en: Senegal Case: A Typical Medicine Distribution Model in West Africa

blocks.zh: 塞內加爾（Senegal）的供應鏈代表了西非較為成熟的公共供應體系：
blocks.en: Senegal's supply chain represents a relatively mature public supply system in West Africa:

blocks.zh: PNA（Pharmacie Nationale d'Approvisionnement）：中央醫藥採購局，統一採購基本藥物清單（EML）品項，向下供應地區醫藥倉庫。PNA實施WHO PQ和/或其他國際標準作為採購門檻。
blocks.en: PNA (Pharmacie Nationale d'Approvisionnement): the central medical procurement agency, which procures items on the Essential Medicines List (EML) centrally and supplies regional medical stores downstream. PNA applies WHO PQ and/or other international standards as a procurement threshold.

blocks.zh: 縱深配送：中央倉庫（達卡）→ 地區醫藥倉庫（14個地區）→ 區/縣倉庫 → 衛生站（Health Posts）→ 社區健康工作者（CHW）→ 患者
blocks.en: Deep-tier distribution: central warehouse (Dakar) → regional medical stores (14 regions) → district warehouses → health posts → community health workers (CHW) → patients

blocks.zh: 最後一哩挑戰：塞內加爾農村衛生站冷鏈依賴太陽能冰箱（Solar Direct Drive Refrigerators），電網不穩時維持疫苗冷鏈。但在最末端（社區健康工作者至患者），冷鏈往往中斷。
blocks.en: Last mile challenge: the cold chain at rural health posts in Senegal relies on solar direct drive refrigerators, which maintain the vaccine cold chain when the grid is unstable. At the very end (community health worker to patient), however, the cold chain is often broken.

blocks.zh: 私人渠道集中於首都：達卡（Dakar）的持牌批發商服務絕大多數私人藥局，農村私人藥局依賴達卡批發商的定期配送車，間隔可達1-2週。
blocks.en: Private channels concentrated in the capital: licensed wholesalers in Dakar serve the vast majority of private pharmacies, and rural private pharmacies depend on scheduled delivery trucks from Dakar wholesalers, with intervals of up to 1-2 weeks.

blocks.zh: 思考：非洲最後一哩與台灣的對比
blocks.en: Reflection: Last Mile in Africa vs. Taiwan

blocks.zh: 對照台灣與非洲的最後一哩環境，有助於理解GDP標準的普世性與在地適應性：
blocks.en: Comparing the last mile environments of Taiwan and Africa helps in understanding both the universality and the local adaptation of GDP standards:

blocks.zh: 台灣優勢：電力穩定、物流基礎設施完善、TFDA監管能力強、全民健保提供藥品可及性
blocks.en: Taiwan's strengths: stable electricity, well-developed logistics infrastructure, strong TFDA regulatory capacity, and drug accessibility provided by National Health Insurance

blocks.zh: 台灣挑戰：離島（澎湖、金門、馬祖）、原住民部落的最後一哩配送仍存在冷鏈中斷風險
blocks.en: Taiwan's challenges: last mile delivery to outlying islands (Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu) and indigenous communities still carries a risk of cold chain breaks

blocks.zh: 共通挑戰：無論哪個市場，患者端儲存行為（家用冰箱溫度設定錯誤、停電後繼續使用）都是最難管控的環節
blocks.en: Common challenges: in any market, patient-end storage behavior (incorrect household refrigerator temperature settings, continued use after a power outage) is the hardest link to control

blocks.zh: TR46的最後一哩GDP指南，核心精神是：在任何資源條件下，盡可能維護最後一哩的產品品質與患者安全。
blocks.en: The core spirit of TR46's last mile GDP guidance is: under any resource conditions, maintain product quality and patient safety in the last mile as far as possible.

blocks.zh: WHO預認證（WHO Prequalification）的作用機制
blocks.en: How WHO Prequalification Works

blocks.zh: WHO PQ計畫是為何非洲公共衛生項目藥品質量相對可靠的關鍵原因：
blocks.en: The WHO PQ program is the key reason medicines in African public health programs are relatively reliable in quality:

blocks.zh: WHO PQ確保進入公共供應鏈的藥品（第一哩）符合國際標準——但從公共醫藥倉庫到患者手中的最後一哩仍存在溫控和追溯風險。
blocks.en: WHO PQ ensures that medicines entering the public supply chain (first mile) meet international standards, but from the public medical store to the patient's hands, the last mile still carries temperature control and traceability risks.
